statement: A second independently moving subject AT A DISTINCT RANGE causes abstention rather than misattribution in at least 95% of trials, using a multi-target ambiguity gate over an independent spatial channel.
notes: Successor to the falsified CLM-RR-004. The fix is observational, not algorithmic: an ambiguity gate over a second spatial channel abstains when the two channels disagree on the dominant source. Scoped to spatially-distinct intruders; a co-located intruder at a similar range remains unresolvable with two channels (see research_lab/docs/RR-004-root-cause.md).
